The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''450 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. Around that year, the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] finally succeeded in wiping out an infestation of [[beck-tori]] that had been ravaging the planet for the last fifty years.<ref name="Power">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>
